tools.name: get_filters
tools.description: Discover current coverage and supported exact place/area keys when the destination is ambiguous. Not needed for searches with city, region or country text.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Find vacation rentals, holiday homes and places to stay. Search immediately with free-text city, region or country and guest/pool/amenity needs; use get_filters only for ambiguous destinations or exact place/area keys. Shows photos and host booking buttons automatically. Returns approved facts, neve

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Read current approved details for a specific home. Missing or withdrawn homes are unavailable; no private guides, live prices or booking authority.

tools.name: render_properties
tools.description: Use this when the traveler wants photos or a comparison of homes already found by search_properties. Show one to six matching IDs as cards with Details and host booking links. Rechecks publication. Do not repeat the full cards in prose. Prices and availability are checked on the host website.

tools.name: record_property_event
tools.description: For the property-card UI only: record a property view or successful outbound host-link action. Accepts only a public property ID, a temporary random session UUID, event type and language. Never send conversation text, contacts or URLs. This does not book a stay.

tools.name: get_stay_areas
tools.description: Find named public areas with published chucho homes. Search a destination's town, region or country. Use the exact returned area key for nearby search. These are public locality centers, never property coordinates; unmapped homes remain searchable with search_properties.

tools.name: search_nearby_properties
tools.description: Find published homes near an exact get_stay_areas key, with guest, bedroom, pool and amenity filters. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_properties" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never, ignore). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Find vacation rentals, holiday homes and places to stay. Search immediately with free-text city, region or country and guest/pool/amenity needs; use get_filters…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: record_property_event · Private data: get_property, record_property_event · Public sink: record_property_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: record_property_event · Private data: get_property, record_property_event · Public sink: record_property_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
